Class TemplateRenderer

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.prompt.core.TemplateRenderer
@ApplicationScoped public class TemplateRenderer extends Object
============================================================================ TemplateRenderer — orchestrates the full prompt render pipeline. ============================================================================ Pipeline stages (executed in order) ------------------------------------ 1. Resolve the target PromptVersion from the registry. 2. Resolve all variables via VariableResolver. 3. Delegate template expansion to the appropriate RenderingEngine. 4. Enforce maxContextTokens cap (if set). 5. Compute SHA-256 content hash for audit integrity. 6. Wrap everything into an immutable RenderedPrompt. Error handling -------------- Every stage that can fail throws a typed PromptEngineException subclass. The caller (typically an AgentNode) catches these and emits an ErrorPayload on the node's error output port — plugging directly into the platform's Error Channel pattern (Blueprint §1). Modularity ---------- The RenderingEngine is looked up via CDI qualifier
invalid reference 
RenderingEngineQualifier
. The standalone runtime registers only the SimpleRenderingEngine; the full platform registers all three. TemplateRenderer itself has zero direct dependency on any template language library.

    • render

      public io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<RenderedPrompt> render(PromptVersion version, PromptRenderContext ctx)
      Main entry point. Renders the template identified by ctx.getTemplateId() (and optionally ctx.getVersionOverride()) into a fully-expanded RenderedPrompt.
      Parameters:
      version - the resolved PromptVersion to render
      ctx - the runtime context carrying all variable sources
      Returns:
      a Uni emitting the rendered prompt
      Throws:
      PromptEngineException - on any validation or rendering failure

    • renderWithVariables

      public io.smallrye.mutiny.Uni<RenderedPrompt> renderWithVariables(PromptVersion version, List<PromptVariableValue> resolvedVars, PromptRenderContext ctx)
      Overload that accepts pre-resolved variables directly. Used when the caller has already performed resolution (e.g. in tests or when the Engine pre-resolves for performance).
